# A Bell He Does Not Know

*From his perch Gideon knows every bell in Selsior, but lately a new one clanks from the north. He thinks it is the shepherd's hut on the Waystone Meadows. Find out, and see why it rings.*

## Objectives

- Reach the shepherd's hut in [The Waystone Meadows](../maps/waystone_meadows.md)
- Defeat 30 [Ribbon Pig](../monsters/ribbon_pig.md)

## Rewards

- 480 EXP
- 200 mesos
- [Red Potion](../items/red_potion.md) x10
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Gideon](../npcs/gideon.md)
